Learning patterns can be full of movement, excitement and fun!

As part of NUMEX, our Pre-K children at prachiteeborewellroad explored the Go–Stop Pattern through a playful traffic game. They watched the signals, moved when it was time to go, paused when it was time to stop, and even tried to predict what would come next.
 
Through this simple experience, children developed anticipation, self-regulation, listening, and early logical thinking — all while enjoying joyful movement.

Today at prachiteeborewellroad, our little learners celebrated World Heart Day by discovering the amazing rhythm of their hearts! 

Through simple, hands-on activities, children:
Felt and listened to their heartbeat
Moved, jumped and noticed their heart beating faster
Practised slow breathing and watched their heartbeat calm down
Talked about simple ways to care for their hearts — moving, eating well, drinking water, resting and sleeping.
Little hearts, big learning! 

“My heart works for me every day. I can take care of my heart.”

Our Makerspace Event at Prachitee Experiential School Whitefield was filled with excitement as our children actively participated in hands-on activities, explored new ideas, created, experimented and learned through joyful experiences! 

A special shout-out to all our wonderful parents who turned up today to see our children in action and experience the learning outcomes behind each activity. 

Our parents also explored:
 Knot & Loop – beautiful handmade crochet creations
The Open Jar – Little Spice Scouts – a sensory journey into Indian spices through play and creativity

Here’s a little glimpse of today’s wonderful moments, celebrating the efforts of our children and educators!

Helping Hands, Happy Hearts!

Our Playgroup children enjoyed a lovely puppet story, “Udak Helps a Little Bird,” at prachiteeborewellroad.

Through the story, children learnt that helping others can make everyone feel happy. They joined in with splish-splash sounds, stretched high, flapped like little birds, and even helped the cloud float! 

A joyful way to learn about kindness, caring and helping others.

Our Pre-K children at prachiteeborewellroad explored the /o/ sound with Ollie Octopus! Through fun puppet games, sound guessing, singing and echo activities, they practised listening and recognising the sound.

They also strengthened their little fingers by rolling, pressing and shaping playdough, while spotting things that begin with the /o/ sound. 
Learning sounds became a fun experience through play, movement and exploration!

"Build and Test"

Our K-1 children at prachiteeborewellroad explored Build & Test in Makerspace! They built their moving projects, tested how they worked, and made changes when something didn’t work as expected. 

Through this hands-on experience, children practised problem-solving, testing and trying again while discovering how small changes can make a big difference.

Hands Can Speak! 

Today at Prachitee Experiential School Whitefield, our children celebrated the International Day of Sign Languages by exploring how we can communicate without using our voices.

Through simple Indian Sign Language signs like Hello, Thank You, Friend, Help and Happy, children discovered that there are many ways to communicate, connect and include everyone. 

Our little learners used their hands, faces and gestures to share messages, play together and understand one another.

Little hands can communicate. Learn. Sign. Include.

Build a Skeleton!

Our K-2 children prachiteeborewellroad became little makers as they built their own skeleton models using cotton buds and paper.
 
They explored the bones in their arms, legs and ribs, compared their models with their friends. 

Through this hands-on activity, children discovered how our skeleton helps us stand, move and protects important parts of our body. They also learned new words like skull, ribs and spine while building and sharing their ideas. 

Learning about our body became a fun make, explore and discover experience!

Our little Plant Explorers enjoyed guiding their visitors, sharing their learning, and celebrating their green journey together!

A lovely day of learning, sharing, and growing at Prachitee!

AAARAMBH – Happy Beginnings at prachiteeborewellroad!

Our Playgroup children started their day with AARAMBH, a simple morning routine filled with warm greetings, music and joyful activities. They placed their photos on the board, sang and clapped with instruments, talked about the weather, practised breathing with their little buddies, built towers together and shared what makes them smile. 

These little moments helped our children feel comfortable, connected and happy at school, making every morning a happy beginning.

Our Pre-K children at prachiteeborewellroad explored “Painting with Nature” by using leaves, twigs, flowers and feathers as their paintbrushes! 

They experimented with different textures, patterns and marks, discovering that nature can become a wonderful tool for creativity. 

A fun, hands-on experience where little artists explored, compared and created!

Estimate the Weight

Our K-2 children at prachiteeborewellroad had fun exploring weight through a hands-on activity!

They held mystery bags, felt their weight and guessed which one was heavier or lighter. Then, they used a balance scale to check their guesses.
Through this activity, children learned to estimate, predict, check and verify—all while having fun! 

Little hands, big thinking!

Hindi Diwas at Prachitee!

Today at prachiteeborewellroad, our children celebrated Hindi Diwas by speaking simple Hindi words, singing rhymes, greeting their friends, and enjoying little conversations in Hindi. 

It was a joyful way to listen, sing, speak, share and celebrate Hindi while also appreciating the many languages we speak at home.

Happy Engineers’ Day 

Engineers’ Day at prachiteeborewellroad!

Today, our children learned about Sir M. Visvesvaraya and explored how engineers think, build and find solutions during Makerspace. 

A special thank you to our parent volunteer Mr. Piyush for joining us and sharing about the world of engineering with our little engineers!

Today at prachiteeborewellroad-Our Community Sharing Celebration 
As part of the “Delicious Discoveries” project, our K-1 children became little hosts and invited our teachers and staff to a special Community Sharing Celebration.
They welcomed their guests, served fresh fruit salad and lemon-mint water, and enjoyed sharing the food they had prepared together. 
A beautiful day of sharing, caring and coming together — showing our children that many little contributions can create one wonderful celebration.

International Dot Day at prachiteeborewellroad

Today, our little learners explored how one small dot can become many possibilities! 

Through stories and fun dot activities, children created their own colourful dot artworks and enjoyed expressing their ideas in their own way.

At Prachitee, we believe every big picture begins with one little dot!
International Dot Day inspires children to believe in themselves, take the first step, and discover the joy of learning through creativity.

A beautiful celebration at prachiteeborewellroad!

A day filled with learning, smiles, and happiness!

World Literacy Day at Prachitee Experiential School Whitefield! 

This World Literacy Day, our little learners celebrated the joy of reading, recognising, and connecting with letters and words! 

From recognising their first letters to reading their first sentences, every little step is a big achievement! 
Little readers today, confident learners tomorrow!

Today, I Am the Teacher!
Today at prachiteeborewellroad, our little learners became teachers for a day! 
Our kids took turns teaching their friends, showing movements, explaining games, and sharing things they know. It was so lovely to watch them lead with confidence and help each other learn. 
Through this fun experience, our children discovered that being a teacher means listening, explaining, helping, being patient and encouraging others. 
And of course, we ended the day with a big “Thank You, Teacher!” 
Happy Teachers’ Day from our little teachers at Prachitee!

Community Helpers Showcase 

Our K-2 learners at prachiteeborewellroad happily showed their families what they had noticed, tried, and made better during the week. They talked about their ideas, showed their work, welcomed their families, and shared lots of smiles. 

It was wonderful to see our children feeling so proud and confident as they shared their learning with the people they love.

We noticed. We tried. We made it better. And we shared it together!
